chunks: “The indication of the sun’s decline is that you take a stick whose length is one cubit and four fingers, then place four fingers into the ground. So when the shadow diminishes until it reaches its limit, then increases, the sun has declined. And the gates of the heaven are opened, the winds blow, and great needs are fulfilled.”

key_terms.أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ: the gates of heaven, indicating a blessed time
key_terms.الظِّلُّ: the shadow whose shortening and lengthening indicates zawal
key_terms.الْحَوَائِجُ الْعِظَامُ: great needs or major requests that are fulfilled
key_terms.زَوَالِ: the sun’s decline from the meridian at midday
key_terms.عُودًا: a stick used for measuring the shadow
key_terms.غَايَتَهُ: its utmost limit, meaning the shortest point

ai.seo_question: How can the time of zawal be determined according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains a practical way to identify the sun’s decline from the meridian by observing the shortest point of a stick’s shadow. It also describes this time as spiritually significant, when the gates of heaven open and great needs are fulfilled.
